note: Set A is significantly better because it preserves scientific notation (E+9) in stiffness values, whereas Set B frequently drops the exponent (e.g., 89.13 vs 89.13E+9), rendering claims wrong by orders of magnitude. Set B also invents values (e.g., height 28.34 m) and garbles attribute names more often. Set A has some misreads and duplicates but is far more faithful to the source data.
remarks: Set B's systematic failure to extract scientific notation correctly makes most stiffness claims engineering-useless. Both sets confuse mass center elevation with total tower height in at least one claim.
